name: green-japan-jobs-scraper
title: Green Japan Jobs Scraper: IT and Web Jobs
description: Scrape IT and web job listings from Green (green-japan.com): title, company, salary range, prefectures, skills, remote flag and the full job page. Search by keyword. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# Green Japan Jobs Scraper Scrape IT and web job listings from Green ([green-japan.com](https://www.green-japan.com/)), a large Japanese job board for engineers, designers and web staff. You get the title, company, salary range, prefectures, skills, remote flag and update time for every job, and with one switch the full job page: description, requirements, salary details, working hours, holidays, benefits, selection process and company profile. The text stays in Japanese, as the site writes it. ## What you get - One row per job, read from the structured result list of Green, not from page links. Recommendation blocks on the page are not mixed in. - The annual salary as written (for example 750万円〜900万円) and as numbers in yen. - Every prefecture of the job, the skill tags, the feature tags and a full remote flag. - Optional: the job page with every public text block as HTML and plain text, plus the company profile. - Each job once per run, even when several keywords or pages show it. - A run with no input returns the newest 5 jobs. Up to 60 jobs per keyword (the most Green shows without login). ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/green-japan-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `green-japan-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "golang" (engineer roles in Tokyo). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "golang" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as golang, React or エンジニア. Each keyword is its own search. Empty means the newest jobs. | | `prefectures` | Only jobs located in one of these prefectures, written in Japanese, for example 東京都 or 大阪府. The short form 東京 works too. | | `remoteOnly` | true keeps only full remote jobs (フルリモート). | | `minSalary` | Only jobs whose annual salary starts at this amount or higher, in units of 10,000 yen. 600 means 6,000,000 yen. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. Default 200. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. | Green shows at most 3 result pages (60 jobs) per search to visitors without login. The prefecture, remote and salary filters are applied to the rows after they are read, so they work on those 60 jobs per keyword. The `_html` fields are built from the plain text of the site: paragraphs and line breaks, nothing else. ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0012 per job result ($1.20 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [JobKorea Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobkorea-kr-scraper): Jobs from JobKorea, a major job board in South Korea. - [JustJoin.it Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/justjoinit-scraper): IT jobs with salary ranges from JustJoin.it. - [NoFluffJobs.com EU Scraper - Engineering Jobs & Salaries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/nofluffjobs-eu-scraper): Engineering jobs and salaries from NoFluffJobs. - [Indeed Jobs Scraper - 60+ Countries, $0.06 per 1,000 Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/indeed-http-scraper): Indeed jobs in over 60 countries. ## FAQ **Can I search in English?** Yes.
